title: Tech stocks pull U.S. markets lower, Anthropic shares plunge in pre-market trading
summary: U.S. markets are pushing lower on Friday, including Anthropic shares on their second day of trading.

image.caption: Stocks on the tech-heavy Nasdaq exchange fell on Friday, the day after Anthropic's historic IPO booked double-digit gains. (CP/AP images)

blocks.text: U.S. markets are pushing lower on Friday, including Anthropic shares on their second day of trading.
U.S. stocks are sliding the day after Anthropic's blockbuster IPO
U.S. futures are lower as Anthropic's market debut did little to quell jitters tied to artificial intelligence and computer chips.
Futures for the S&P 500 dropped 0.7 per cent on Friday, while those for the Nasdaq slid 1.5 per cent.
The Nasdaq's newest stock, AI giant Anthropic, is down more than 10 per cent in pre-market trading.
Futures for the Dow Jones Industrial Average were down 0.1 per cent.
The S&P 500 fell on Thursday for a sixth straight loss. That's its longest losing streak in 2 ½ years. Meanwhile, the Dow closed below 50,00, the first time that's happened since June.
